sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri S.K. Pandey - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Ekta Gupta - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State.

ORDER This is the second bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.21 of 2024 registered at Police Station Ghamapur, District- Jabalpur for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.
First bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 09.05.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 16999/2024.
As per the prosecution case, the allegations against the present applicant is that applicant established physical relationship with prosecutrix on the false pretext of marriage.

Later on,
applicant refused to marry the prosecutrix.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that in the instant case incident is dated 19.12.2021 and last incident is dated 10.12.2023 and report has been lodged on 12.01.2024.
Thus, there is delay in lodging the FIR but no explanation has been furnished for the same.
Prosecutrix 2 MCRC-33797-2024 is major.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
There is nothing in FSL report to support the prosecution story.
Applicant is in jail since 02.04.2024.
Early conclusion of trial of this case is not possible in near future.
On above grounds, it has been prayed that applicants be released on bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State on the other hand has opposed the bail application.
I have heard both learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.
In view of overall facts and circumstances of the case including nature of evidence available on record, I deem it appropriate to allow this application.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is Vikas @ Vikki Dahiya vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109561609/
1 directed that the applicants be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
